doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast and Revision of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 通期連結業績予想の修正並びに剰余金の配当（中間配当）及び期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 通期連結業績予想の上方修正に伴い、配当性向40％を目安とする基本方針に基づいて実施

name_jp: 東京ラヂエーター製造
summary_en: Annual dividend per share raised to ¥87.00 from prior forecast of ¥77.00, including interim dividend of ¥42.00 and revised year-end dividend of ¥45.00. Increase reflects upward revision of full-year earnings forecast, with payout ratio targeting 40%.
summary_jp: 通期配当を1株当たり87円に修正。中間配当42円、期末配当を45円に増額。業績予想の上方修正に伴い、配当性向40％を目安とする基本方針に基づいて決定。
